description: This file defines interfaces, data structures, and constants related to the Git commit-graph feature, including functions for loading, parsing, writing, and verifying commit graphs, as well as managing commit graph data within a repository.

classes.name: commit_graph
classes.description: Data structure representing a commit graph, including pointers to data chunks, metadata, and associated settings used for managing commit graph information within a repository.

classes.name: commit_graph_data
classes.description: Structure holding commit graph position and generation number, used for tracking commit metadata.

methods.name: git_test_write_commit_graph_or_die
methods.description: Function used in testing to write a commit graph or terminate on failure.

methods.name: get_commit_graph_filename
methods.description: Retrieves the filename of the commit graph for a given source.

methods.name: get_commit_graph_chain_filename
methods.description: Retrieves the filename of the commit graph chain for a given source.

methods.name: open_commit_graph
methods.description: Opens a commit graph file and retrieves its file descriptor and status.

methods.name: open_commit_graph_chain
methods.description: Opens a commit graph chain file with specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: parse_commit_in_graph
methods.description: Attempts to fill commit information from the commit graph, returning success status.

methods.name: repo_find_commit_pos_in_graph
methods.description: Finds the position of a commit within the commit graph.

methods.name: lookup_commit_in_graph
methods.description: Looks up a commit by ID within the commit graph.

methods.name: load_commit_graph_info
methods.description: Ensures commit info is fully loaded and consistent with the commit graph.

methods.name: get_commit_tree_in_graph
methods.description: Retrieves the tree object associated with a commit from the graph.

methods.name: load_commit_graph_one_fd_st
methods.description: Loads a commit graph from a file descriptor and file status.

methods.name: load_commit_graph_chain_fd_st
methods.description: Loads a chain of commit graphs from a file descriptor.

methods.name: read_commit_graph_one
methods.description: Reads a single commit graph from source.

methods.name: parse_commit_graph
methods.description: Parses a commit graph from memory mapping.

methods.name: generation_numbers_enabled
methods.description: Checks if generation numbers are enabled in the repository's commit graph.

methods.name: corrected_commit_dates_enabled
methods.description: Checks if corrected commit dates are enabled.

methods.name: get_bloom_filter_settings
methods.description: Retrieves bloom filter settings for the repository.

methods.name: write_commit_graph_reachable
methods.description: Writes a reachable commit graph with specified options.

methods.name: write_commit_graph
methods.description: Writes a commit graph including specified commits and pack indexes.

methods.name: verify_commit_graph
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of a commit graph.

methods.name: close_commit_graph
methods.description: Closes the commit graph associated with an object database.

methods.name: free_commit_graph
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a commit graph.

methods.name: disable_commit_graph
methods.description: Disables the use of commit graph in a repository.

methods.name: commit_graph_generation
methods.description: Returns the generation number of a commit from the graph.

methods.name: commit_graph_position
methods.description: Returns the position of a commit in the graph.

methods.name: ensure_generations_valid
methods.description: Ensures all reachable commits have valid generation numbers.
